nodes.label: Case Editor UI - ERP Implementation Dispute (NovaSoft)
nodes.description: Screenshot of Captio's case editor interface showing a legal case document for an ERP implementation dispute. The UI displays an editing toolbar with 'Editando...', 'Respuestas del cliente', 'Guardar cambios', 'Descargar HTML', and 'Eliminar' actions. The case content shows: Classification as 'Contrato de servicios — Incumplimiento y defectos en implementación de sistema ERP'. Key points (PUNTOS CLAVE) include: $1.8M MXN ERP implementation contract with NovaSoft Sistemas S.A. de C.V.; client paid $1.08M MXN advance in March 2024; system delivered with 47 documented incidents, 12 unresolved 5 months after agreed deadline (real delivery: 30 Sep 2024); quantified damages of $2.4M MXN in cancelled orders plus $800k MXN in SLA penalties; NovaSoft offered 20% discount on remaining balance which client rejected; formal breach notification on 5 Dec 2024; client seeks rescission, advance refund, lost profits indemnification, and performance bond execution; main risk is potential counterclaim for 'scope changes' and NovaSoft dissolution. A timeline section shows a consultation scheduled for Tuesday at 1:13:18 PM on 4/6/2026.
